chapter: Solo years, marriages and the Canadian party
title: His own touring unit in Germany, Italy and France
summary: He ran a revue of dancing and singing for Special Service and she did jazz and kick tap.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: However, when I showed her some dancing -- we did some shows, we went to Italy and all. I had a unit of my own over there
and I brought the unit throughout -- certain places -- I went to Italy, I went to France with this revue I had and I got commendations from the Special Service.
You had put this show together yourself.
It was basically a variety show?
Yeah, the show I put together was, yeah.
It consisted of dancing, singing, that's all.
This woman that you subsequently married, what kind of dancing did she do?
What do you call it -- what do you call that dance -- it's like a jazz dance plus kicks, that's about the size of it, kicks and jazz dancing, that's what
she did and did a tap to go with it. She did a kick, tap, dance. It was a good review, very good. I thought so. We got a lot of praise with it.
